root_cause_layers: Planner /26 & Registry /33 (altitude foot derivation onto intersection line `AB`)

selection_rationale: Together, `DEV72-G2` (trapezoid & isosceles triangle base templates) and `DEV72-G3` (rhombus 60°/120° base & lateral face perpendicular to base) unlock 6 of the 9 remaining `DEV72` cases (raising `DEV72` coverage from 63/72 [87.5%] to 69/72 [95.8%]) while remaining 100% within closed-form exact `Fraction`/`Radical` arithmetic with zero GPU/AI overhead.
